title: Security of Single-Key CLRW2
summary: No attack is known on CLRW2 when its two underlying blockcipher keys are equal; prove the variant secure or find an attack.

formal_statement.body: For the CLRW2 construction, investigate the single-key variant in which its two underlying blockcipher keys are identified, $K_2=K_1$: either establish the security of this variant or find an attack against it. No attack is known for this variant, but adapting the existing proof is non-trivial because the bound on $\beta_1$ requires tracing the game execution history to determine when $\pi_1$ becomes defined, and this becomes more difficult to verify when $\pi_2=\pi_1$.

scope.domain: Security analysis of the single-key CLRW2 tweakable-blockcipher construction.
parameters: K1 and K2: the two underlying blockcipher keys, constrained to be equal
scope.unresolved_remainder: Establish the security of the equal-key CLRW2 variant or find an attack against it.

citations.label: Tweakable Blockciphers with Beyond Birthday-Bound Security

progress.summary: The source presents the equal-key CLRW2 variant as future work, reports no known attack, and says adapting the proof is non-trivial because tracking when π1 becomes defined is harder when π2 equals π1.
citation_labels: Will Landecker et al., Tweakable Blockciphers with Beyond Birthday-Bound Security
